scientific_integrity: The combinatorial definition, integer chain calculations, signed group-action checks and complete code are included. Nonequivariant Betti ranks potentially follow from a known complementary complex by equivariant Koszul duality; novelty is specifically the concrete integral pairing-lattice identification.
scientific_limitations: A fixed finite multiple chessboard complex; integral action in degree 3, rational action in degree 4, no equivariant homotopy splitting and no integral degree-4 module classification. The supporting finite certificates are exact but independent validation has not been performed.
title: Integral pairing-lattice symmetry of a balanced four-row multiple chessboard complex
